rencrypt(1)                      User Commands                     rencrypt(1)

NAME
       rencrypt  - Encrypt a file using one of several state of the art proto-
       cols

SYNOPSIS
       rencrypt [OPTION]... [FILE]...

DESCRIPTION
       The rencrypt command reads the specified FILE(s), encrypts the content,
       and writes the result to standard output or an output file.

OPTIONS
       -o, --output FILE
              Write the encrypted content to FILE instead of standard output.

       -p, --protocol
              Which  protocol to use. The acceptable options are "rev", "cap",
              and "doub" where "rev" is most secure but takes the longest  and
              "doub" is the least secure but fastest.

       -h, --help
              Display this help message and exit.

       -v, --version
              Output version information and exit.

EXAMPLES
       Encrypt the contents of `input.txt` and print to standard output:

       rencrypt input.txt

       Encrypt the contents of `input.txt` and write to `output.txt`:

       rencrypt input.txt -o output.txt

       Encrypt the contents of `input.txt` with a different protocol:

       rencrypt input.txt -p cap

       Display help information:

       rencrypt -h

       Display version information:

       rencrypt -v
